description: Direct k-anonymity lookup: pass the first 5 hex chars of a SHA-1 password hash, get back all SHA-1 suffixes with their pwned counts. Use this if you're hashing client-side and only want to send the prefix.

suffix_count.description: Number of matching SHA-1 suffixes found

suffixes.description: Array of suffix/count pairs matching this prefix

count.description: Number of times this hash seen in breaches

suffix.description: SHA-1 suffix (35 hex chars after prefix)
